about: Worker C's settings sweep (Nov 16): one clean launch per variant at con_custodial y0_p0 (measured again at the end of each launch after one look round the room), one setting changed against the play-setup baseline. Each launch checks remix-dxvk.log lists every rtx key with the new value.
